title: Austin's Gas Supply Future Debated
summary:
*   A special public hearing was held to evaluate proposals for Austin's future natural gas supply.
*   Representatives from several companies, including Texas Central Gas, Intra-State Gas, and Southern Union Gas, presented their bids to provide gas services.
*   A city-hired consultant discussed his expert evaluation and analysis of the competing gas supplier proposals.
*   The council concluded the extensive hearing, which lasted late into the evening, and recessed to continue deliberating on this significant utility decision.
